Definition: a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness
BiblicalUsage: A stronghold is a fortress and a hiding place, and the psalms make it a name for God Himself: the LORD is my rock and my fortress, and my deliverer, and David says the same in his song of deliverance. The word is also used for the holds where David hid from Saul, and for the fortresses where Ezekiel's exiles take refuge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word teaches us where to run: David hid in real strongholds, but the psalms say the LORD Himself is the fortress, and no stone wall ever kept a man the way God does. I hold that the safest place on earth is not a cave or a castle, but the name of the LORD.
